anchor.policy: Old263 integer MSE <= epoch-zero MSE; no anchor gradients

change: Fit only existing output weights with actual-default-profile matched-horizon comparison witnesses and exposed tactical counterexamples; preserve old data, MSE and all guards
comparison: Only after the newly reserved-position move-choice gate passes: basic classical Regicide,16 games,100ms

data.pair_target_policy: Old pairs keep their original provenance. New live comparison gaps are teacher root-child differences through observed completed-PV support endpoints, NOT literal teacher labels at those endpoints. The forced branch matches completed depth and default options but is a frozen-search surrogate.
data.partition_policy: Source families and mirrored piece features disjoint across point/pair partitions
data.test_limit: Old69already exposed; newly reserved gate separate from all gradients and checkpoint selection
data.test_policy: Score once after final checkpoint saving; never optimize, stop, rank, or retry

gate_policy.exposure_policy: Every recorded neural FEN/root_fen/source/root wrapper, complete history prefix, teacher/native/development PV continuation; all previous gate roots and legal children; color/rank-mirror canonical feature identity
gate_policy.limitations: M2 source families were previously observed; only these extended roots and all legal children are absent from the recorded learning/selection/teacher/probe inventory. This is a small move-choice screen, not independent Elo evidence.
gate_policy.native_build_binding: Sealed before current learning collection or fitting
gate_policy.selection: Fixed odd source indices1..31; UCI-lexicographic first legal noncapture/noncheck moves for exactly4plies; only recorded feature overlap allows extending same path to6 then8 then10plies; no other refill, no teacher/model outputs

loss_definition: point teacher MSE + 1.0 * mean(old sibling gaps and teacher root-child gaps through verified support leaves) + 4.0 * old-TRAIN frozen-warm-prediction MSE; all normalized by10000 for gradients

preservation.gradients: Old TRAIN1426 only; complete normalized preservation mean per point minibatch
preservation.target: Frozen initial quantized white-cp output, not replacement teacher labels

selection: One seed/run; minimum tuning point MSE + pair-gap MSE subject to anchor guard; epoch0 protection and best restoration

training_mask.policy: Freeze initial float bytes and quantized values of piece inputs, hidden biases and turn inputs. Only existing sixteen output weights enter Adam.
